content: We had an outstanding fourth quarter, with total revenue expanding to $160 million. Over 70% of our enterprise customer tier has enabled our AI Copilot suite. We are demonstrating rapid adoption and operating leverage, validating our position as the mission-critical AI platform for enterprise workflows.

Elena, congratulations on the top-line growth. However, looking at the cost structure, gross margins contracted from 79% in Q1 2024 to 61% in Q4 2025, an 1,800 basis point drop. How much of this is structural cloud inference costs versus temporary scaling friction?

Thanks Marcus. What we are seeing is unprecedented user engagement. When customers run millions of Copilot sessions, we capture long-term platform stickiness. We believe the customer lifetime value and enterprise expansion opportunities will dwarf any near-term gross margin fluctuations as model costs naturally decline over time.
